_comment: DEVELOPMENT AND TESTING ONLY. The install script downloads Bethesda-copyrighted Skyrim master files from a third-party mirror. Do not use this egg on a public or commercial node, and do not distribute it. Use egg-alduinak-server.json for anything real.
name: Alduinak Server (dev, auto-fetches game files)
author: ezekielj221@gmail.com
description: DEV ONLY. Identical to the Alduinak Server egg except the install step downloads the Skyrim master files from the mirror this repository's CI uses. Those files are Bethesda's property and this is not a licensed redistribution channel. Internal testing only.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# DEV ONLY: fetches Bethesda-copyrighted master files from a third-party mirror.
# This is the same source this repository's CI uses for tests. It is not a
# licensed redistribution channel. Never run this egg on a public node.

set -e

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
mkdir -p /mnt/server/world
mkdir -p /mnt/server/gamemode_extensions

SE_DATA_BASE="${SE_DATA_BASE:-https://gitlab.com/pospelov/se-data/-/raw/main}"

cd /mnt/server/data
for esm in Skyrim.esm Update.esm Dawnguard.esm HearthFires.esm Dragonborn.esm; do
  if [ -f "$esm" ]; then
    echo "$esm already present, skipping"
    continue
  fi
  echo "fetching $esm"
  curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$esm" "${SE_DATA_BASE}/${esm}"
done

cat > /mnt/server/data/DEV-BUILD-DO-NOT-DISTRIBUTE.txt <<'EOF'
The .esm files in this directory were downloaded automatically by the
development egg. They are Bethesda's copyrighted game files.

This server is for internal testing only. Do not expose it publicly and do
not distribute this volume or any image built from it.
EOF

echo "Dev install complete."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Shown in the launcher and on the master list.

variables.name: UI / metrics port
variables.description: TCP port for the http endpoints (static data, /metrics, /rpc). This must be a SECOND allocation assigned to this server, and must not equal the game port. Add the allocation under the Network tab first.

variables.name: Offline mode
variables.description: 1 = any profile id may connect and the master API is ignored. 0 = sessions are validated against the master API.

variables.name: Master API URL
variables.description: Backend URL used for session validation when offline mode is 0. Leave blank for a standalone server.

variables.name: Master key
variables.description: Shared secret; must match the backend SERVER_MASTER_KEY.

variables.name: Database driver
variables.description: file = flat changeForms in world/. mongodb = external MongoDB, needs the URI below.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: Directory name for the file driver, database name for mongodb.

variables.name: Database URI
variables.description: MongoDB connection string. Only used when the driver is mongodb.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Localisation used for game strings loaded from the data directory.
